text: A photorealistic still life scene on a dark wooden table with dramatic side lighting from the left. The main subject is a transparent glass vase filled with exactly 7 red roses, positioned in the center-left. The vase must cast a clear shadow extending to the right, and the shadow must be at least twice the width of the vase. Behind the vase, place a matte black ceramic bowl containing exactly 3 green apples. The bowl's rim must be partially visible behind the vase but the bowl itself must NOT be transparent. To the right of the vase, position a shiny metallic silver spoon lying flat, with its reflective surface clearly showing a distorted reflection of the vase. The spoon handle must point toward the bottom-right corner at exactly 45 degrees. In the background, a soft-focus cream-colored fabric backdrop with visible texture folds. The lighting must create a strong highlight on the left side of the vase and the metallic spoon, while the right side of the scene remains in soft shadow. The overall color temperature must be warm (golden hour lighting, approximately 3000K).

A complex layered composition viewed from directly above (bird's eye view). Bottom layer: a large rectangular white paper (A4 size) with the exact text 'LAYER 1' printed in the top-left corner in 24pt Arial font. Middle layer: a smaller blue translucent plastic sheet (half the size of the white paper) positioned at a 30-degree rotation, covering the center of the white paper. The blue sheet must be semi-transparent so 'LAYER 1' text is still partially visible through it. The blue sheet has the exact text 'LAYER 2' in white letters in its center. Top layer: a small yellow sticky note (1/4 the size of the blue sheet) placed on the top-right corner of the blue sheet, with the exact text 'LAYER 3' in black handwriting style. The yellow note must NOT cover any part of 'LAYER 2' text. Additionally, place exactly 4 identical red paperclips: one on each corner of the white paper, and each paperclip must be partially on the paper and partially off the edge. A thin black pen must lie diagonally across all three layers, starting from the bottom-left corner of the white paper and ending at the top-right corner of the blue sheet. The pen must be clearly visible on all layers it crosses. Shadows must be consistent with a single overhead light source positioned slightly to the right.

A realistic photograph of a long corridor with strong linear perspective, shot from one end looking toward a vanishing point. The corridor has white walls and a gray tiled floor with a black-and-white checkered pattern. Along the left wall, place exactly 5 identical red fire extinguishers mounted at equal intervals, decreasing in apparent size due to perspective. Each extinguisher must be clearly visible and none should be occluded. Along the right wall, place exactly 3 blue doors at equal intervals, and each door must have a silver door handle on the left side. The first door (closest to camera) must be fully closed, the second door must be half-open (45-degree angle), and the third door (farthest) must be fully open (90-degree angle). On the floor, paint a continuous yellow safety line running down the exact center of the corridor from foreground to vanishing point, and this line must be perfectly straight and follow the perspective correctly. Hang exactly 6 identical white fluorescent light fixtures on the ceiling, evenly spaced, and each light must cast a rectangular pool of light on the floor below it. The lighting must create a gradient from bright in the foreground to dimmer in the background. At the far end of the corridor, place a green exit sign with the exact text 'EXIT' in white letters, and this sign must be clearly readable despite the distance.

An abstract geometric composition with perfect bilateral symmetry along a vertical center axis. Background: a smooth gradient from deep purple (#4A148C) at the top to bright cyan (#00BCD4) at the bottom, transitioning smoothly through exactly 5 visible color bands. Foreground elements (all perfectly mirrored left-right): On each side, place exactly 3 concentric circles with the following properties: outer circle is red with 5px stroke and no fill, middle circle is yellow with solid fill, inner circle is white with solid fill. The circles on the left must be positioned at 30% from the left edge and 40% from the top. The circles on the right must be the exact mirror image. Between the two circle sets, place a vertical white line (2px width) running from top to bottom, dividing the composition exactly in half. Above the center line, place the exact text 'SYMMETRY TEST' in bold white sans-serif font, perfectly centered horizontally. Below the text, place exactly 4 pairs of triangles: each pair consists of one triangle pointing up and one pointing down, arranged in a horizontal row. The triangles must alternate colors: red, blue, green, orange (repeated for the mirrored side). Each triangle must be equilateral with 40px sides. The triangles must be positioned so that the up-pointing and down-pointing triangles in each pair touch at their tips, forming a diamond shape. All elements must maintain perfect pixel-level symmetry across the vertical center line.
